asi-iar.note: Annual series. Properly paginated and the preferred source for excavation facts — who dug, when, what was found. Cite volume year and page.

basham1954.title: The Wonder That Was India

sircar-epigraphy.author: Sircar, D. C.

sii.author: Archaeological Survey of India

periplus.author: Casson, Lionel (ed. and trans.)
periplus.title: The Periplus Maris Erythraei

thapar-asoka.note: The standard study for the Ashokan inscriptions chapter.

thapar-somanatha.author: Thapar, Romila
thapar-somanatha.title: Somanatha: The Many Voices of a History
thapar-somanatha.note: The historiographical treatment of the Somnath raid and its later narration.

kalhana-rajatarangini.author: Kalhana (trans. M. A. Stein)
kalhana-rajatarangini.title: Rajatarangini: The Saga of the Kings of Kasmir
kalhana-rajatarangini.note: The Kashmir chronicle, 1149-50 CE. Cite book and verse.

nilakanta-sastri-colas.author: Nilakanta Sastri, K. A.
nilakanta-sastri-colas.title: The Colas
